patch.value: Desired contract: mutation commands emit an idempotent bounded receipt with item id, appended annotation identity or index, author, timestamp, changed count, omission metadata, and an explicit opt-in to restore history. Apply the same response shape to comments, notes, and learnings through shared SDK primitives. Preserve stored history exactly; change only the default mutation projection. Add a realistic long-lived fixture so token-budget gates measure the write path.
pm comments write response replays the entire accumulated history, so one append can emit hundreds of comments

Appending a comment with pm comments <id> <text> returns the full comments collection instead of a bounded mutation receipt or only the appended entry. On the long-lived release-health item pm-7zs0, a single 2026-08-04 evidence append replayed hundreds of historical comments and dominated a 100k-token command batch. The read-side --limit contract does not protect the write response. This is a distinct CLI/SDK output-contract gap from the closed MCP read issue pm-6vfg.

comments, notes, and learnings writes return a bounded shared SDK mutation receipt by default.; Explicit full-history opt-in preserves current inspection capability and emits omission receipts otherwise.; A long-lived fixture proves output size is independent of prior annotation count within the declared token budget.; CLI, SDK, MCP, schemas, docs, and completion contracts remain aligned.
pm CLI 2026.8.4 on the 2,310-item dogfood repository
Run pm comments pm-7zs0 with one new evidence string and inspect stdout; the response enumerates the complete historical comments array.
A bounded mutation receipt returns only the appended comment and omission metadata; full history requires explicit opt-in.
The successful append returns every accumulated comment, making output grow without bound over project lifetime.
Agents spend context tokens re-reading immutable history on every evidence append, directly opposing token-efficient project context management.

value.text: Duplicate check 2026-08-04: searched every status for comments mutation output, full accumulated comment history, append response token bloat, bounded latest-comment receipt, and annotation output budgets. Closed pm-6vfg fixed the MCP read path; open pm-5t33or owns universal output ceilings; closed annotation-stack items cover input and deduplication. No active or terminal item owns the CLI and shared-SDK write-response projection that reproduced on pm-7zs0.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Same defect confirmed on the notes surface, not only comments, at 2026.8.7 on 2026-08-07: `pm notes <id> --add` replayed the entire accumulated note stream in its write response — 43KB for a single append on an item carrying 15 notes. Scope note for the fix: the replay is a property of the annotation write envelope, so comments, notes and learnings should be corrected together rather than one at a time. Workaround that works today is --quiet.
